statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The patient reports persistent episodes of palpitations that interfere with daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to evaluate the frequency and burden of arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial is based on missing prior authorization
